title: Portfolio chat profile
description: Everything the chatbot knows about one person. Only `schemaVersion` and `name` are required; the bot skips topics a profile does not cover. Everything here ends up in a public widget, so do not put private data (phone number, salary, home address) in it.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema. Lets older files be migrated if the format changes.

bio.description: Two or three sentences. Used for "who is this / about" questions.

availability.description: e.g. "Open to opportunities". Shown with contact details.

summary.description: A short sentence answering "what is your tech stack?".

items.description: Individual skills. Mentioning any of them in a question also triggers the stack answer.

faqs.description: Anything that does not fit the other fields: relocation, timezone, rates, why the chatbot exists...

title.description: Chat panel header. Defaults to "Ask about <name>".

greeting.description: First message the bot shows when the chat opens. Defaults to a short hello that names you; "" shows no greeting.

suggestions.description: Quick-question links shown under the greeting until the visitor sends a message (the first 3 by default). Each should be answerable: a topic question, a project, or an faq `q`.

declineMessage.description: Reply to questions outside the bot's scope.

url.description: Must start with http:// or https://. Other schemes (javascript:, data:) are rejected.

type.description: Groups the project list. Defaults to "other".

role.description: What you did, e.g. "Started the app from scratch and added new features."

link.description: Must start with http:// or https://.

q.description: The question. Also matched exactly, so it can be used as a suggestion button.

keywords.description: Words or phrases that trigger this answer in free text.
